# Allen & Allen

> Virginia-based personal injury law firm with 100+ years of experience serving clients across Richmond, Charlottesville, Fredericksburg, and surrounding areas.

Allen & Allen is a full-service personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, medical malpractice, wrongful death, and catastrophic injuries. The firm is deeply committed to community involvement through scholarships, charitable partnerships, and advocacy programs.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Medical Malpractice
- Car Accidents
- Wrongful Death
- Traumatic Brain Injury
- Catastrophic Injuries
- Workers' Compensation
- Virginia Attorney Services
- Community Involvement
- Case Results
- George E. Allen Scholarship
- MADD Partnership
- FeedMore
- Legal Services
